summary: IRGC announced agreements with Oman on the Strait of Hormuz, stating US must accept its conditions for the strait to open. IDF destroyed a Hamas ambush point approximately 50 meters from the Yellow Line in Jabaliya, northern Gaza, near Kamal Adwan Hospital. Trump's statements reported by Israeli media claim Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei is severely injured rather than dead, with Trump predicting a 'victory in Iran' soon.
key_points: IRGC announced agreements with Oman on the Strait of Hormuz, stating US must accept Iran's conditions or the strait will not open. (Source: @asafroz/52777)

IDF destroyed a Hamas ambush point and weapons storage in Jabaliya, northern Gaza, approximately 50 meters from the Yellow Line, 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospital, and 170 meters from a school; several militants killed. (Source: @idf_telegram/24989)
Trump stated in a radio interview that Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei is severely injured on the left side of his body, including hand and leg, and is not dead. (Source: @asafroz/52781)

Report indicates Oman has stopped cooperating with US to facilitate escorted tanker movements through southern Hormuz, with no vessels passing in 24 hours and an Indian vessel returning after warning shots. (Source: @presstv/204272)

The Lebanese army announced it thwarted a weapons smuggling attempt from Syria to Lebanon, seizing multiple anti-tank rockets (RPG-7 and RPG-29) intended for Hezbollah. (Source: @New_security8200/203445)
Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani will visit Tehran on Friday, announced by Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei. (Source: @SharghDaily/180248)
Palestinian media reports one dead and several injured in an Israeli strike targeting a tent in the Khan Younis area of southern Gaza. (Source: @manniefabian/59043)
IDF reported over 400 terror infrastructure targets destroyed and numerous weapons located in Golani Brigade operations in the security zone. (Source: @idf_telegram/24995)

sections.executive_summary: IRGC announced agreements with Oman on the Strait of Hormuz, stating that US must accept its conditions for the strait to open. IDF destroyed a Hamas ambush point approximately 50 meters from the Yellow Line in Jabaliya, northern Gaza, near Kamal Adwan Hospital and a school. Trump claimed in a radio interview that Iran's Khamenei is severely injured rather than dead, and predicted a coming 'victory in Iran.'
iran: IRGC spokesman announced agreements reached with Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz, covering both countries' shares in the strait's waters and revenues. The spokesman stated that if the US stops creating difficulties and returns to understandings reached, the strait can be opened within that framework, but the strait will not open if the US does not accept Iran's conditions. (Source: @asafroz/52777)

Trump stated in a radio interview that Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei is severely injured on the left side of his body, including his hand and leg, and is not dead. Trump added that senior Iranian leadership is constantly 'putting on a show' that they are coming to receive Khamenei's blessing. (Source: @asafroz/52781)

Report indicates Oman has stopped cooperating with the US to facilitate escorted tanker movements through southern Hormuz, with no vessels passing via the Omani route in 24 hours and an Indian vessel returning after receiving warning shots. (Source: @presstv/204272)

Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei announced that Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani will visit Tehran on Friday. The visit is described as part of ongoing Iran-Qatar consultations to expand bilateral relations and strengthen regional peace and security. (Source: @SharghDaily/180248)

Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman criticized the US, stating that the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier was deployed to the region for a 'power display' and after months of war and more than 200 days without a single port docking, the carrier is now heading to Thailand for R&R. (Source: @SharghDaily/180254)

Iran's representative for China affairs welcomed China's principled position in rejecting illegal US sanctions against Iran, stating the strategic partnership is based on mutual respect and win-win cooperation and does not need anyone's permission, according to Speaker Qalibaf. (Source: @SharghDaily/180245)
israel: IDF reported that the Golani Brigade (Division) operations in the security zone resulted in the destruction of over 400 terror infrastructure targets and the location of numerous weapons. (Source: @idf_telegram/24995)

Minister Ben Gvir updated Hadar Muchtar that she will not be on the Otzma Yehudit list for the upcoming Knesset, recommending she learn Knesset work and arrive more prepared in the future. Muchtar's associates responded with surprise, stating she is a 'Bibist' and never asked for a slot. (Source: @amitsegal/64262)

A walla poll shows the 'Am Yisrael' party led by Ofer Winter receiving 6 seats, Likud continuing to weaken, and Smotrich's Religious Zionism remaining below the electoral threshold with 2.6%, while the Netanyahu bloc stands at 49 seats. (Source: @yediotnews25/134341)
Trump stated 'we had a victory in Venezuela and we're going to have a victory in Iran soon,' according to an i24 report. (Source: @inon_yttach/9956)

The IDF Home Front Command held a ceremony marking the return of the 'Brit A'im' delegation from Colombia after 12 days of activity at destruction sites; the commander stated no missing persons remain in Cali. (Source: @idf_telegram/24993)
gaza_west_bank: IDF destroyed a Hamas ambush point and weapons storage in Jabaliya, northern Gaza, approximately 50 meters from the Yellow Line, 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospital, and 170 meters from a school; several militants were killed. The IDF stated terror routes were planned from the building against IDF forces and attempts were made to restore the organization's capabilities. (Source: @idf_telegram/24989)

Palestinian media reports one dead and several injured in an Israeli strike targeting a tent in the Khan Younis area of southern Gaza. There was no immediate comment from the military. (Source: @manniefabian/59043)

The US Trump administration designated the organization 'Palestine Action' in Britain as a terrorist organization and imposed sanctions on it, citing responsibility for a series of attacks on security facilities identified with Israel. (Source: @asafroz/52785)
lebanon: The Lebanese army announced it thwarted an attempt to smuggle weapons from Syria to Lebanon. The shipment contained multiple anti-tank rockets for RPG-7 and RPG-29, which were apparently intended for the Hezbollah terror organization. (Source: @New_security8200/203445)
Israeli media reports the IDF carried out a large explosion in the town of Mansouri in southern Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387077)
syria_iraq: Suicide drone attack targeted Kurdish opposition headquarters in Erbil, with flames and smoke columns rising from the separatist headquarters in Ervil province. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88593)

Three Yemeni ballistic missiles fell in Saudi military warehouses in the port of Mocha, according to reports of two explosions in Mocha caused by missiles launched by Ansar Allah (Houthis). (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387078)

sections.threat_assessment: The IRGC's announcement of agreements with Oman on the Strait of Hormuz, combined with the report that Oman has stopped cooperating with US escorted tanker movements, represents a significant escalation in the maritime domain and could threaten global energy supply routes. Trump's statements regarding Khamenei's alleged injuries and prediction of an imminent 'victory in Iran' suggest the US may be preparing further pressure or actions against Iran. The Lebanese army's seizure of RPG-7 and RPG-29 rockets destined for Hezbollah from Syria indicates continued Hezbollah rearmament efforts despite ceasefire arrangements. In Gaza, the IDF's continued operations against Hamas infrastructure near the Yellow Line demonstrate persistent threats to forces even in areas governed by the agreement.
sections.regional_response: Qatar's Prime Minister will visit Tehran on Friday for bilateral and regional security consultations, indicating ongoing diplomatic engagement between Iran and Gulf states amid the Hormuz tensions. Iran's foreign ministry criticized the USS Abraham Lincoln's deployment as a mere 'power display' that ended with the carrier heading to Thailand for R&R after 200+ days without port docking. The US designated 'Palestine Action' in Britain as a terrorist organization, widening the counter-terrorism front. The Yemeni ballistic missile strikes on Saudi military warehouses in Mocha and continued Houthi operations indicate persistent regional proxy activity.
sections.intelligence_notes: The IRGC's explicit statement that the Strait of Hormuz will not open if the US does not accept Iran's conditions, combined with reports of warning shots to an Indian vessel, suggests Iran is willing to escalate militarily in the maritime domain. Trump's claims about Khamenei's injuries remain unverified and could be part of psychological pressure campaign. The Lebanese army's interdiction of anti-tank rockets from Syria indicates active smuggling routes remain operational despite monitoring efforts. The proximity of the Hamas ambush point (50m from Yellow Line, 70m from hospital, 170m from school) demonstrates how Hamas embedded military infrastructure within civilian areas, complicating IDF operations under the agreement framework.
